records.population: 396 children in Kuwait and 256 children in England, ages approximately 5-7; analysis focuses mainly on Grades/Years 1-2
records.notes: The study includes X0X three-digit numbers and directly reports omission-of-zero errors such as 504→54 in the Kuwaiti sample, while that pattern was absent in the English sample for the comparable item. The authors link errors to language-specific number-name structure. Use as evidence that the error can occur and can be language-mediated; do not generalise it to Chinese-speaking pupils or all place-value learners.
